description: Local-first, policy-controlled, auditable code harness built on Pi's existing AgentHarness.

userStories.title: Branch and Ralph bootstrap
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a repository-local Ralph run contract so that each implementation iteration has durable scope and memory.
acceptanceCriteria: Branch is ralph/code-harness and starts from main.
Ralph PRD, prd.json, runner, agent instructions, progress log, and archive directory exist.
bash scripts/ralph/ralph.sh --dry-run succeeds.
userStories.notes: Branch, Ralph files, and dry-run verified on 2026-08-30.

userStories.title: Single-lane durable runtime
userStories.description: As an SDK caller, I want one harness lane to prompt, execute tools, queue messages, abort, wait, and watch.
acceptanceCriteria: Supported AgentHarness operations no longer return HarnessNotImplemented.
Prompt, tool ordering, queues, abort, idle waiting, and watch snapshots are deterministic.
npm --workspace=@earendil-works/pi-agent-core run test:harness passes.
userStories.notes: Single-lane Agent loop, message persistence, queues, abort, watch, skills, and templates verified by focused tests.

userStories.title: Recovery, retry, and persistence
userStories.description: As a long-running task, I want operation boundaries and retries to survive interruption without duplicating effects.
acceptanceCriteria: Operation, step, tool, queue, and terminal records replay idempotently.
Retry counts and backoff are bounded and observable.
Corrupt or interrupted records fail closed with typed errors.
Existing Pi session format remains unchanged.
userStories.notes: Operation recovery, step-attempt retry, JSONL corruption/duplicate guards, and memory storage tests pass.

userStories.title: Policy and approval core
userStories.description: As a user, I want predictable permission decisions so effects cannot silently exceed task policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Policy, rule, decision, approval, and enforced execution types are public.
deny, ask, allow, and mode precedence plus once/session/persistent scopes are tested.
Compound commands and path escapes never auto-allow.

userStories.title: Task lifecycle and audit
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a durable Plan -> Execute -> Verify task backed by reviewable evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Required task states and explicit plan approval are enforced.
Verification evidence and bounded, redacted audit output are persisted globally per project.
Required verification failures prevent completed status.

userStories.title: Execution backends and Git worktrees
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I want backend-neutral execution and safe worktree ownership.
acceptanceCriteria: Local execution wraps existing ExecutionEnv/BashOperations contracts.
SandboxAdapter capability and lifecycle contracts are public.
Worktree manager refuses dirty baselines and preserves harness-unowned paths.
Child writes return reviewable patch or commit evidence.

userStories.title: Bounded subagent orchestration
userStories.description: As a coordinator, I want role-based child agents without unbounded permissions or resources.
acceptanceCriteria: Planner, implementer, and reviewer roles support inherited defaults and explicit model overrides.
Concurrency four and recursion depth one are hard bounded defaults.
Child policy cannot exceed the parent and merge requires coordinator approval.

userStories.title: Harness protocol namespace
userStories.description: As an SDK or future IDE client, I want a stable harness protocol for task state and approvals.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing CBOR framing and legacy protocol v1 remain unchanged.
Harness snapshots, revisions, progress, approvals, and audit summaries are schema validated.
Client/server tests cover stale, duplicate, denied, and disconnected approvals.

userStories.title: Harness CLI
userStories.description: As a local developer, I want explicit harness commands for planning, execution, verification, and inspection.
acceptanceCriteria: pi harness plan, run, verify, and status are functional and documented.
Human and JSON event output modes work.
.pi/harness.json version 1 validation and trust diagnostics are surfaced.
Existing pi commands retain current behavior.

userStories.title: End-to-end validation and residue guard
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a real local smoke and forbidden-behavior checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Temporary Git smoke covers approval, pause/resume, worktree, verify, audit redaction, and failure stop.
Dirty worktree, path escape, compound command, network capability, duplicate recovery, and merge conflict cases are covered.
Supported operations do not regress to HarnessNotImplemented.
npm run check and ./test.sh pass.
